course.title: Spoken English Confidence

days.title: Say hello and greet people

Write down five of your own examples using greetings like hello, good morning and how are you.

days.challenge: Greet a stranger, like a shopkeeper, in English.

quiz.q: Which greeting fits the morning?
options: Good morning
Good night
Goodbye
See you
quiz.explain: We say good morning in the morning. Good night is for bedtime.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?

family words: mother, father, sister, brother
describing people: tall, kind, funny, hard-working

quiz.explain: Today's focus was greetings like hello, good morning and how are you.
